t: This is Regent Street, a major shopping street in the West End. It runs from Waterloo Place in St James's, through Piccadilly Circus and Oxford Circus, up to All Souls Church. The name comes from George, the Prince Regent, later George IV, who financed the designs. The architect John Nash laid it out, working with the property developer James Burton. Nash was responsible for many important areas of London in the neoclassical and picturesque styles. From All Souls, Langham Place and Portland Place carry the route on towards Regent's Park.
